hubs.name: M32 Gen 5 "Antares"
hubs.description:
A symphony inspired architecture designed to run a kernel (or a full OS if you push it enough). It has:
* 65Kb RAM and Persistent Memory
* 1Kb external ROM
* 16Kb VRAM
* Complete with a (basic) MMU for paging an Virtual Memory
The Kernel itself starts at 0xe000 in RAM. It has a 512 tick interrupt built it which hands control to Kernel code every 512 ticks (disabled in Kernel Mode and reset when going from Kernel -> User Mode)

hubs.name: Overture With RAM
hubs.description:
Exactly what it says on the tin. Overture with 256 bytes of RAM available.
The RAM address is controlled with PTR (r4), and RAM can be read from r5.
To write to memory, you can perform a st operation to store the value in
ACC (r3) to RAM at the address present in PTR. You can also use mov ram, (any address,
it still reads from ACC anyway) to write the value in ACC to RAM. This isn't
meant to be practical, but more to answer a "can I?". The old saying, "He asked if he could,
but never if he should" applies strongly here. Have fun :-)

hubs.name: ieee754float32
hubs.description:
IEEE-754 Float32 Adder/Subtractor (custom logic)

Features

Add / subtract for IEEE-754 float32
Round to nearest, ties to even (RNE)
Special values: NaN, ±Inf, ±0, subnormals (gradual underflow)
Overflow → ±Inf
Special value encodings (hex)

NaN: 0x7FC00000 (exp all-1, mantissa ≠ 0)
±Inf: 0x7F800000 / 0xFF800000
±0: 0x00000000 / 0x80000000
subnormal: exp = 0, mantissa ≠ 0 (e.g. 0x00000001)
Input

+/- : mode (0 = add, 1 = sub)
A, B : IEEE-754 float32
Output

out : A ± B in IEEE-754 float32
⚠ NOT INDEPENDENTLY TESTED — please help verify!

hubs.name: Symphony Secondary Decoder
hubs.description:
Based on the Mode and the Opcode, this will tell you what memory ports to enable, what IO devices to use, which registers to load or store, etc.

Register Instructions:
bit 0: Load A
bit 1: Load B
bit 2: Store

Memory Instructions:
bit 0: load_8
bit 1: load_16
bit 2: load_32
bit 3: pload
bit 4: store_8
bit 5: store_16
bit 6: store_32
bit 7: pstore

IO Instructions:
bit 0: nop
bit 1: in
bit 2: out
bit 3: keyboard
bit 4: screen
bit 5: time_0
bit 6: time_1
bit 7: counter



IO Mode (00):
0: No Operation
1: Store
2: Load B
3: Store
4: Load A, Load B
5: Store
6: Store
7: Store

ALU Mode (01):
Enable ALU, Load A,
Load B, Store

JUMP Mode (10):
Load A, Load B,
Enable Jump Mode

MEM Mode (11):
0: Store, Load B
1: Store, Load B
2: Store, Load B
3: Store, Load B
4: Load A, Load B
5: Load A, Load B
6: Load A, Load B
7: Load A, Load B
hubs.author: Xera

hubs.name: RISC32I最小核心带外设
hubs.description:
[b]RISC32I 最小核心[/b] — 图灵完备内搭建的 RV32I 单周期 CPU，37 条指令全覆盖，可运行 LLVM 编译的 C 程序。哈佛架构，指令 ROM 与数据 RAM 各从 0x00000000 编址。

[b]外设 (MMIO)[/b]
0x80000000 关卡 I/O | 0x80000004 键盘 | 0x80000008-0C 64位系统时钟(纳秒) | 0x80000010-1C 16位数码管(段码: dp,g,f,e,d,c,b,a)

[b]编译[/b]
[code]clang --target=riscv32-unknown-elf -march=rv32i -mabi=ilp32 -nostdlib -ffreestanding -O2 -c crt0.S main.c
ld.lld -T link.ld crt0.o main.o -o out.elf
python3 elftohex.py out.elf[/code]

[b]链接脚本[/b]
[code]MEMORY { ROM(rx):O=0,L=256K RAM(rw):O=0,L=256K }
ENTRY(_start)[/code]

[b]示例[/b] 附 time_display.c — 纯 RV32I 软件乘除, 16 管实时显示 YYYYMMDD HHMMSScc, 零 ROM 数据读, 开箱即跑。
